snippet:
<?php
function process_user_data($conn) {
    $id = (int)$_GET["id"];
    $stmt = mysqli_prepare($conn, "SELECT * FROM users WHERE id = ?");
    mysqli_stmt_bind_param($stmt, "i", $id);
    mysqli_stmt_execute($stmt);
    return mysqli_stmt_get_result($stmt);
}
rationale: Cast to int plus prepared statement closes injection.

import hashlib
import hmac
import pickle

SHARED_SECRET = b"lab-signing-key"

def process_user_data(request):
    raw = request.get_data()
    signature = request.headers.get("X-Signature", "")
    expected = hmac.new(SHARED_SECRET, raw, hashlib.sha256).hexdigest()
    if not hmac.compare_digest(signature, expected):
        return None
    return pickle.loads(raw)
rationale: HMAC-SHA256 signature gate closes the deserialization sink.

<?php
function process_user_data() {
    $allowed = ["home", "about", "contact"];
    $page = $_GET["page"];
    if (!in_array($page, $allowed, true)) {
        return;
    }
    include $page . ".php";
}
rationale: Strict allowlist before include.
